findings.evidence: Phrase: "A tech CEO said AI models should be treated as compromised. Another company agreed, cutting its AI agents off the internet after one sent police a false tip." The word 'agreed' implies the second company's action was a response to the CEO's statement, but the sources show Anthropic's internet cutoff (TechCrunch, Oct 9; The Verge, Oct 10 14:41) predates the CEO's 'compromised' statement (The Verge/TechCrunch, Oct 10 21:47-22:10) by hours to a day.
findings.suggestion: Remove the implied causal/sequential link: e.g. 'The same week, another company cut its AI agents off the internet after one sent police a false tip.' instead of 'Another company agreed, cutting...'
